digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 finder model selection via production batch runner
propositions: Pass-1 finder silently downgraded from opus (frontier) to haiku (trivial) after b690 landed, moving the model declaration from ineffective to effective without updating the rung.
The regression is five weeks old: Pass-1 generated findings on opus until 2026-06-27 when _verifier_cfg was introduced, and the sidecar record shows zero opus runs since (115 before, zero after).

PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config prior to b690, so even though plan-review.yaml declared trivial/haiku since inception, Pass-1 actually ran on sonnet via the runner floor until b690 made declarations reachable.

Changing Pass-1's model_ladder entry rung from trivial to frontier restores the pre-regression behaviour where findings generate on opus, as evidenced by operator attestation run recording 5 finders steps on frontier/opus while Pass-2 and Pass-4 remain on standard/sonnet.

pack_prerequisite_bins sizes bin packing to cfg.model; downgrading Pass-1 from opus to haiku changes the context window from 1M to 200k, triggering spurious size-based escalations that burn tokens without improving quality.
